thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty SEV2 triggered — elevated 5xx rates observed at the API gateway. Top error classes: auth 502, org-lookup timeouts, billing 504s. Affected routes: /v1/models/* (control plane calls). Thresholds crossed at 1768504200. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/controlplane-deps

oncall-mike: Acked. I’m on it. Paging SRE rotation and eng-oncall. Any immediate mitigation suggestions?

anya: seeing a spike in auth 502s in the logs — looks like org-lookup is timing out and the gateway surfaces as 502/504. Quick check:
```
$ curl -i https://auth-internal.prod.svc/validate -d '{"token":"x"}'
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
content-type: application/json
{"error":"upstream gateway error: org-lookup timeout"}
```

leia: same. Metrics: auth latency p50 -> 120ms normally, now p50=900ms, p95=2.3s. Org-lookup error rate went from 0.2% -> 18% in last 3m.

alice-eng-sre: looking at org-lookup pods — multiple restarts on node pool cp-idx-2. kube events show OOMs ~1768504100. Dumping last 200 lines from org-lookup:
```
E 2026-02-21T12:05:08Z org-lookup service error: context deadline exceeded
W 2026-02-21T12:05:10Z memory pressure: RSS 1.9GB > limit 1.6GB
I 2026-02-21T12:05:11Z restarting container
```

product-sam: We have two enterprise customers on Dedicated capacity hitting 503s; support tickets inbound. Notifying CSMs now. Customer impact: generation calls failing for ~5-10% of requests, rate fluctuates but causing retries and client timeouts.

oncall-mike: Immediate mitigation proposal: (1) route gateway traffic away from cp-idx-2 node pool (cordon + drain) to reduce noisy neighbors; (2) enable API-level circuit breaker to short-circuit org-lookup and fall back to cached org metadata for reads; (3) temporarily increase org-lookup replicas and memory limit if nodes have capacity. Which is cheapest to execute now?

ops-rotation: cordon/drain needs ~5m and will cause transient routing. Circuit breaker toggle is config change, low risk. Scaling requires cluster capacity — checking autoscaler status.

alice-eng-sre: I can flip the circuit-breaker flag in the control plane config quickly. Oncall-mike, want me to do that now? It will bypass org-lookup for non-critical metadata and use cache (stale <=5m).

oncall-mike: Do it. Post the config change and the rollback steps. Also we’ll add a temporary quota to reduce retries from clients (set 429 on repeated attempts) to avoid amplifying load.

alice-eng-sre: Applying toggle now.
```
# PATCH /configs/control-plane
{ "org_lookup": { "fallback_cache_only": true, "cache_ttl": 300 } }
```

alice-eng-sre: Done. Config applied via config-service; config commit id: cfg-7f3b2. Propagating to 6 clusters.

leia: metrics after toggle: org-lookup error rate down from 18% -> 6% in 90s. Gateway 5xx rate dropping. Latency p95 trending back toward 600ms.

billing-team: we saw billing-related 504s too — probably secondary to same org-lookup dependency. Are we confident cache-only won't affect billing reconciliation? Need to flag side effects.

product-sam: Noted. I'll inform impacted accounts that we're routing through cache temporarily; there may be minor metadata staleness. Escalating to enterprise success for high-touch customers.

anya: also start increasing org-lookup replicas as a second mitigation. alice, can you queue a scale to +3 for replicas? If nodes have capacity, prefer scale over draining nodes.

alice-eng-sre: Issuing scale now (HPA override):
```
kubectl scale deployment org-lookup --replicas=6 -n control-plane
```
Scale request accepted; new pods scheduling.

ops-rotation: Autoscaler had some headroom; two new pods scheduled on cp-x1 nodes. Monitoring memory and CPU.

oncall-mike: Good. Next: check for config regressions or recent deploys that might have changed memory limits — correlate with deploy history. anya, can you grep deploys > 1768500000 for org-lookup?

anya: checking.. found a deploy at 1768499800 from release-team that bumped a dependency. The pod spec memory still 1.6Gi. No recent memory limit bump. However the deployed binary has a regression re: cache eviction path — opening issue.

alice-eng-sre: Opening rollback PR for the last release; if scaling + circuit-breaker doesn't fully mitigate we'll rollback to 1768499700.

incident-bot: :information_source: Incident channel created: #inc-1768504321. Pagerduty notes: page sent to oncall-mike and eng-oncall. Severity: SEV2. Impacting: Hosted API customers (generation endpoints), Dedicated affected for some enterprise routes.

leia: After 8m from toggle & scale, gateway 5xxs reduced ~75%. Error budget burn slowed. We should keep circuit-breaker for 30m and monitor for correctness. Rolling back toggle if not needed.

billing-team: Confirming no billing inconsistencies so far. We'll run a reconciliation job after full recovery.

product-sam: Customer comms draft: "We're investigating elevated 5xx errors caused by an upstream org lookup service. We've applied a temporary mitigation that reduces errors by using cached org metadata; work continues to restore full service. We'll update every 30 minutes." Can share to CSMs now.

oncall-mike: Handing over to night on-call in 30m. @ops-rotation please prepare a short incident summary and mitigation steps for handoff. If organics degrade, escalate to SEV1.

ops-rotation: Will prepare summary. Current action items: 1) keep circuit-breaker enabled for 30m, 2) monitor pod restarts and memory usage, 3) follow up on rollback PR if errors persist, 4) run billing reconciliation post-recovery.

alice-eng-sre: Follow-up: rollback PR created (PR#3321). If we see error rate > 5% for another 10m, we execute rollback.

oncall-mike: Thanks team. Logging timeline & RCA notes in the runbook. I'll update incident status to "mitigated" once metrics hold for 20m.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation in place — circuit-breaker and scale. Continue monitoring.

ops-rotation: Incident summary for handoff:
- root cause (likely): org-lookup instability caused by OOMs on cp-idx-2 -> timeouts bubbled up as 502/504 at gateway
- mitigation: enabled fallback cache (cfg-7f3b2), scaled org-lookup to 6 replicas, cordon plan for cp-idx-2 if needed
- customer impact: elevated 5xx for generation endpoints, some enterprise customers affected; communicated to CSMs
- next steps: rollback PR ready, monitor memory, investigate root regression in binary and fix cache eviction bug

leia: tagging incident as "mitigated" tentatively. Will reopen if error rate creeps up. :thumbsup:

oncall-mike: Handoff complete. Thanks all.

product-sam: leaving notes for post-incident review. We should add a synthetic test for org-lookup fallback path to catch this earlier.

incident-bot: Incident channel archived to #inc-1768504321-archive after handoff.
